title: Movement Under Extremist Leadership
definition: A radical phase of the Indian National Movement (1905-1917) characterized by the shift from 'mendicancy' (petitions/prayers) to 'Swaraj' (self-rule) through mass mobilization, boycott, and swadeshi.
importanceInUpsc: Essential for understanding the evolution of nationalist ideology, the Surat Split, and the transition from moderate constitutionalism to militant mass-based agitation.
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Movement Under Extremist Leadership.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
